name: dietetic-erp
description: Sistema ERP completo para dietética con POS, inventario y balanza

scripts.install:all: npm install && cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.setup: cd backend && npx prisma generate && npx prisma db push && npx prisma db seed
scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.start: concurrently "cd backend && npm start" "cd frontend && npm start"
